About Channel:
Praja Chaithanyam is your top source for reliable, Unbiased news updates from Telugu States and across the globe. Operating Out of Hyderabad, Praja Chaithanyam covers news from every corner of Telugu States.  We at Praja Chaithanyam, favour high-quality programming and news, rather than sensational infotainmen


Watch AP Public Talk 2029 Elections and NDA Governance. Praja Chaitanyam brings Real Public Bytes from all across state. We cover public opinion Day to Day Political Counter from Leaders and Public. We Share Reports on Who will win in their constituency.
